entry_state: The primitive registry distinguishes review,temporal selection,compilation,history construction,uncertainty admission/selection,projection,accounting and storage effects. Closed records bind accounting basis and authorization without forward receipt references; synthetic evidence cannot authorize a real-book posting. Method definitions preserve unknown preconditions and capability limits. OrderedEPS/1 defines exact context-bound rational inputs,complete inventories and chronology,ordered comparisons and distinct unresolved/unsupported/blocked/rejected results. Its report mutates nothing and leaves live freshness and source truth to application methods.
exit_state: AppendixA ends with CompanyEPSJoin/1: a finite read-only bridge recomputes legal books,tax,consolidation and weighted shares for conversion-at-maturity and redemption worlds,with separate company and EPS failures. AppendixB preserves the teaching grammar without extending the initial parser. Historical records and new portable contracts remain distinct. Currency typing does not replace context checks;logical answers require nonempty full-family feasibility. Rule selection uses unique maximal applicable rules and atomic event effects. The conditional borrowing request keeps its two outcomes separate and rejects an unconditional mean without weights. The R1–R10 table maps requirements to conformance cases.

findings.observation: The company-to-EPS bridge cannot substitute group profit or closing shares for the required ordinary numerator and weighted denominator;its two-world scope is explicit.

The preserved grammar and schemas are historical references,while semantic checks,unknown values and new posting contracts retain separate obligations. Both displays have local definitions and immediate operational interpretations.
